scenarios.scenario: Reduce the full ribbon to compact group buttons

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part document is open in the MCAD Software
the View ribbon tab displays its full groups of commands
the user opens the ribbon display menu
Minimize to Panel Buttons is selected
the user dismisses the menu with Escape
the full View ribbon remains visible
the user activates the ribbon display control once
the View ribbon shows compact buttons for Visibility, Appearance, Windows and Navigate
the viewport has more vertical space
the user selects the Windows group button
a temporary panel displays that group's commands
the user activates the ribbon display control again
the full View ribbon is restored
the temporary Windows panel closes

scenarios.scenario: Open a group from the title-only ribbon

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part document is open in the MCAD Software
the full View ribbon is visible
the user opens the ribbon display menu
Minimize to Panel Buttons is selected
the user selects Minimize to Panel Titles
the View ribbon displays group titles in a narrow strip
the user selects the Windows group title
a temporary panel displays the Windows commands
the user activates the ribbon display control
the full View ribbon is restored
the temporary Windows panel closes
the user opens the ribbon display menu again
Minimize to Panel Titles is selected
the user selects Minimize to Panel Buttons
the View ribbon displays compact group buttons
the user activates the ribbon display control again
the full View ribbon is restored

scenarios.scenario: Access a ribbon tab in tabs-only mode

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part document is open in the MCAD Software
the ribbon display control is configured to cycle through all modes
the View ribbon displays its group titles
the user activates the ribbon display control once
the ribbon shows its tabs without the group strip
the user selects the View tab
the View commands appear in a temporary panel below the tabs
the user activates the ribbon display control
the expanded View ribbon is restored
the user clicks in an empty area of the viewport
the expanded View ribbon remains visible
the user chooses Minimize to Panel Buttons from the ribbon display menu
the ribbon displays compact group buttons
the user activates the ribbon display control once
the full ribbon is restored
`fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part document is open in the MCAD Software
Minimize to Tabs is the selected ribbon display mode
the user opens the ribbon display control menu
the menu offers minimization to tabs, panel titles and panel buttons
it offers a cycle-through-all choice
Minimize to Tabs is checked

scenarios.scenario: Choose tabs-only mode and switches ribbon tabs

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part document is open in the MCAD Software
the full Tools ribbon is visible
the user opens the ribbon display control menu
the user chooses Minimize to Tabs
the command groups are hidden and the ribbon tabs remain visible
the user selects the 3D Model tab
its command groups appear temporarily below the tabs
the user clicks an empty area of the viewport
the temporary command groups close
the 3D Model tab remains selected
the user opens the ribbon display control menu
Minimize to Tabs is checked

scenarios.scenario: Inspect a selected minimization policy while the full ribbon is open

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the full Tools ribbon is visible
Minimize to Tabs is the selected ribbon display policy
the user opens the ribbon display policy menu
Minimize to Tabs is marked as selected
Minimize to Panel Titles, Minimize to Panel Buttons and Cycle Through All are listed
the full Tools ribbon remains visible
the user dismisses the menu with Escape
the menu closes without changing the display policy
the full Tools ribbon remains visible
